memory.whyItIsLoadBearing: The editor target's generated documentation-translation unit is compiled as one ~102 MB translation unit. MSVC rejected it with fatal error C1060 at -j8, at -j4 and at -j1 with nothing else running, so compiler heap - not parallelism - is the binding host constraint for that target.
